basic_details.job_title: IISER Berhampur Technical Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Indian Institute of Science Education and Research Berhampur (IISER Berhampur), an Institute of National Importance under the Ministry of Education, Government of India, has advertised 1 temporary Technical Assistant post on a BRNS-funded project. Applications are sent by email to the Principal Investigator at [email protected], and the last date of applications is 5:00 PM on Saturday, 21 November 2026. The pay is ₹ 25,000 consolidated per month.

qualification.details: Qualification (as per guidelines): B.Sc or M.Sc. Degree in Geology/Applied Geology/Geological Sciences or any relevant discipline. Experience: the application must briefly mention experience relevant to the job requirement. Type of engagement: Temporary. Period of engagement: 1 year from the date of joining, extendable based on the progress, performance and availability of funds for up to 3 years. | The project is "Study on hydrothermal process and its bearing on uranium mineralization in Sarangapalli and Tangeda area, Palnad Sub-Basin, Cuddapah Basin, Palnadu district, Andhra Pradesh". The funding agency is BRNS (file no. 41/14/11/2026-BRNS/879), and the IISER BPR project no. is IISERBPR/EES/BRNS/051026/3758/103. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

selection_process: The date and mode of the interview will be informed later to the shortlisted candidates through email. The notice does not describe any other stage.

faq.question: Q1. How many Technical Assistant posts has IISER Berhampur advertised?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 1 Technical Assistant post, on a temporary basis.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IISER Berhampur Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The last date of applications is 5:00 PM on Saturday, 21-11-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IISER Berhampur Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: The notice asks for a B.Sc or M.Sc. Degree in Geology/Applied Geology/Geological Sciences or any relevant discipline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the salary of the Technical Assistant at IISER Berhampur?
faq.answer: The remuneration is ₹ 25,000 consolidated per month.

faq.question: Q5. How do I apply for the IISER Berhampur Technical Assistant post?
faq.answer: Email a CV with all supporting documents in a single pdf (less than 10 MB) to the Principal Investigator at [email protected], with a brief mention of experience relevant to the job requirement.

faq.question: Q6. What subject line should I use in the email?
faq.answer: Use "Application for the Position of Technical Assistant against advt. no. IISERBPR/EES/BRNS/051026/3758/103/Technical Assistant dated 06-11-2026".

faq.question: Q7. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: The date and mode of the interview will be informed later to the shortlisted candidates through email.

faq.question: Q8. Is the IISER Berhampur Technical Assistant post permanent?
faq.answer: No, the type of engagement is Temporary. The period is 1 year from the date of joining, extendable up to 3 years based on progress, performance and availability of funds.

faq.question: Q9. What work will the Technical Assistant do?
faq.answer: The job requirement is rock sample crushing, powdering, thin-section-wafer preparation, and instrument set-up, calibration, and maintenance.
